rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for a small group packed close together.

example.english: There was a huddle of people by the entrance waiting to get in.
example.traditional: 門口有一堆人擠埋一齊等入場。
example.jyutping: mun4 hau2 jau5 jat1 deoi1 jan4 zai1 maai4 jat1 cai4 dang2 jap6 coeng4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when people or animals crowd close together.

example.english: After the game, the players huddle together on the sidelines to rest.
example.traditional: 比賽完之後，隊員喺場邊擠埋一齊休息。
example.jyutping: bei2 coi3 jyun4 zi1 hau6 deoi6 jyun4 hai2 coeng4 bin1 zai1 maai4 jat1 cai4 jau1 sik1

rows.note: Use this for players gathering in a circle to plan the next play.

example.english: The players formed a huddle to plan the next play.
example.traditional: 球員圍圈喺場邊商量下一球點打。
example.jyutping: kau4 jyun4 wai4 hyun1 hai2 coeng4 bin1 soeng1 loeng4 haa5 jat1 kau4 dim2 daa2

rows.note: Use this when someone curls up tightly with the legs drawn in and the body compact.

example.english: When I am cold, I huddle up tightly under the blanket.
example.traditional: 我凍親嗰陣會縮埋一嚿，匿喺張被入面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dung3 can1 go2 zan6 wui5 suk1 maai4 jat1 gau6 nik1 hai2 zoeng1 pei5 jap6 min6

rows.note: Use this when people get close together specifically to discuss something.

example.english: Before the meeting, we huddle to discuss the plan.
example.traditional: 開會前，我哋圍埋傾吓個方案。
example.jyutping: hoi1 wui2 cin4 ngo5 dei6 wai4 maai4 king1 haa5 go3 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use this specifically when journalists crowd around someone to ask questions.

example.english: The journalists formed a huddle to ask the mayor why he suddenly resigned.
example.traditional: 記者圍訪市長，問佢點解突然辭職。
example.jyutping: gei3 ze2 wai4 fong2 si5 zoeng2 man6 keoi5 dim2 gaai2 dat6 jin4 ci4 zik1
